notes:
CRM notes: POC-focused account. Primary use-case: ticket deflection + automated support agent. Key requirements: scale to ~4-6M indexed docs (tickets + KB + product docs), peak qps ~60-100 with steady-state 15-30 qps; target end-to-end p95 for retrieval+rerank <= 350ms (goal <= 250ms). Rerank top-5 quality must be high — business metric = top-5 precision >= 0.80 (engineering target 0.85). Cost sensitivity: target infra + model cost per query < $0.02 (prefer < $0.015) for deflections. Prefer open/quantized model variants for reranker (cross-encoder distil or small cross-attention model) but open to Redwood-managed quantized options.

Security: EU data residency mandatory, SSO/SAML for admin, SOC2 + ISO27001 expected, full audit logging + KMS integration for keys, retention controls (6 months for derived embeddings, raw tickets retained per their policy). Legal flagged data residency as blocker — must sign DPA and confirm private control plane or Dedicated VPC option.

POC plan: index 5M historical tickets + FAQ KB, run traffic replay of 2 weeks of production to validate p95 and deflection rate. Evaluate caching (prefix + KV cache) and batching effects on cost/latency. Look for automatic fallback routing if Dedicated capacity saturated.

Tech notes / ask: need guidance on index sizing (estimated 2.4TB raw vectors for 5M @ 512 dims float32; want quantized footprint), recommended reranker architecture (cross-encoder vs. lightweight candidate scorer), suggested batching vs. prefix caching settings to hit p95 SLO. SE ask: sample ingestion pipeline + cost model runbook.

Quotes from stakeholders: CTO: "Can't accept >500ms p95 for support agent; brand risk." Head of Ops: "Budget is fixed for FY26, need clear TAC (total cost) per deflection."

Open items: legal signoff timeline, final POC scope (5M vs 2M docs), infra choice (Dedicated vs Hosted with VPC), agree on success metrics (30% ticket deflection target).
